name: Place a hold on a member's share
description: Restrict a share with a reason code and notes. The host requires a supervisor profile for this function and the hold is irreversible, so it carries both the application's own authorisation boundary and our irreversible-step gate.
goal: Sign on, open member {member_id}, place a hold on share {share_id} with reason {reason_code} and notes {notes}, review it, and apply it.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

outputs.name: confirmation
outputs.description: Confirmation number for the applied hold.
